answer: Sybil defense via exponential identity pricing: minting identities gets pricier the more one source creates — like a glacier advancing, slow then unstoppable. The first identity costs almost nothing; the tenth costs ten times more; the hundredth a thousand times more, with price doubling per identity from the same hardware, stake pool, or sponsor graph. Honest users needing one or two identities barely feel it — a ripple in their budget. Attackers needing thousands of fakes face a terrace of rising costs that outgrows any bot farm's budget. The curve resets only with proven honest history.
